one_liner: Carlos Alcaraz wins at a higher rate on grass (grass_wr_career 0.8974) than on either hard or clay -- an unusual surface ordering for a player raised on clay.
three_things: Grass is his best surface by career rate: 0.8974, against 0.8443 on clay and 0.7717 on hard.
Recent form is stronger still: grass_wr_recent 0.9394 and clay_wr_recent 0.8889.
grass_adapt_career of 0.0858 says he gains on grass rather than losing, unlike most of this set.
context_note: Descriptive career and recent-form surface win rates as of the corpus end -- not a prediction and not an edge claim. Per-surface floors apply (n>=30 career for a surface win rate, n>=25 each side for the clay-minus-hard gap, n>=15 for grass adaptation), evaluated independently for career and recent form; a metric below its floor shows n/a and is never fabricated. Nothing here adjusts for era, opponent quality, draw, or injury.
